description: This Java class 'JmsBasedCredentialsClient' implements a client for interacting with a Credentials service via JMS. It provides methods for creating clients, sending requests, and processing responses related to credentials management within a testing framework.

classes.name: JmsBasedCredentialsClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Credentials service over JMS, including methods for creation, credentials retrieval, and request handling.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new JmsBasedCredentialsClient instance asynchronously. Initiates link creation post-creation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves credentials based on type and authId with default client context.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves credentials based on type, authId, and client context.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a JMS request message with specified operation, properties, and payload, then processes the reply.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Processes the response payload according to status and cache directives, extracting CredentialsObject or handling errors.
